body:
It was my first time with vicodin.  I popped three of the 5/500 milligram tablets, probably more then I should have taken.  To add, I took a little more then a swig of scotch-whisky.  Within the hour, I was relaxed, a sort of headachey.  I passed out on my bed and woke up sick.  I stumbled to my bathroom and vomited countless times.  Whatever I ate i vomited.  Even when I sucked on an ice cube.  And when there was nothing left in my stomach, I got the sensation of throwing up without actually throwing up.  I had an intense hangover, with a mega headache, an unsettled stomach, and I was hungry as hell.  It was the worst drug experience of my life.  I learned a great lesson though, for me, alcohol and vicodin don't mix!
Next time, not so much Vicodin, absolutely no alcohol
